questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What is the term for a massive celestial body that emits light and heat generated by nuclear reactions at its core?
A. Plazma storm
B. Star
C. Comets
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wie nennt man einen massereichen Himmelskörper, der Licht und Wärme ausstrahlt, die durch Kernreaktionen in seinem Inneren entstehen?
questions.en: What is the term for a massive celestial body that emits light and heat generated by nuclear reactions at its core?

timeline.labelEn: Hans Bethe publishes how nuclear fusion (incl. the CNO cycle) powers stars, later earning the 1967 Nobel Prize
timeline.labelDe: Hans Bethe veröffentlicht, wie Kernfusion (u. a. der CNO-Zyklus) Sterne antreibt – 1967 dafür mit dem Nobelpreis geehrt

questions.notes: Card misspells 'Plasma' as 'Plazma'. Timeline: Bethe 1939 paper (Wikipedia 'Hans Bethe').

questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Inventions] Which of the following is the world’s largest hydroelectric power plant?
A. Itaipu Dam
B. Grand Coulee Dam
C. Three Gorges Dam
Answer: C. The Three Gorges Dam, located on the Yangtze River in China, is the world’s largest hydroelectric power station by total capacity, which stands at 22,500 MW. It’s a massive structure known for its electricity production as well as its role in flood control and navigation improvement.
questions.de: Welcher Staudamm am Jangtsekiang in China ist das nach installierter Leistung (22.500 MW) größte Wasserkraftwerk der Welt?
questions.en: Which dam on the Yangtze River in China is the world's largest hydroelectric power station by installed capacity (22,500 MW)?

timeline.labelEn: Three Gorges Dam built: construction begins 14 Dec 1994; the last of its 32 main turbines starts producing in 2012
timeline.labelDe: Bau des Drei-Schluchten-Damms: Baubeginn am 14. Dez. 1994; 2012 geht die letzte der 32 Hauptturbinen in Betrieb

questions.notes: Largest by installed capacity (and world's largest power station of any kind); Itaipu has at times generated more energy in a year.
